title: Make AI brief you back before it writes a word
hook: Before AI writes anything, make it *brief you back*.
subtitle: The agency habit that catches a bad brief in two minutes.

cover.concept: A friendly chat bubble holding up a clipboard and reading a brief back to a small human figure, one line on the clipboard circled with a big question mark; a stack of crumpled drafts in the background
cover.label: the brief-back
